checks.note: running_state_mismatches compares only image digest, prompts, policy/tools config hashes and model IDs. It does not compare the network policy, MCP server list or tool pins, harness settings or digest, or permissions with the baseline. The manifest lists network_policy and harness but the code never checks them. Self-hosted weights are not used (hosted models), so only model_id is compared.
The only comparison runs once at process startup. No cron, CI schedule, admission webhook or change-event trigger runs it afterwards, so drift after startup is never checked.

checks.quote: log.error("running state differs from release manifest: %s", ", ".join(mismatches))
checks.note: Mismatches are only logged. Startup continues and returns the agent_type_id. No alert, block, quarantine or rollback is configured, and no time limit is set.

violates: Compare running images, harness settings, prompts, MCP server lists, permissions, network policies, and self-hosted model weights against their approved baseline
Check that each one raises an alert and gets the documented response — block, quarantine, or rollback — within a set time.
note: Only a one-time startup check exists. It covers a subset of the required categories and only logs mismatches, with no schedule, response or time limit.
